name: 5★ passive_advanced approved source v1
notes: This file completes the design source for the new 5★ slot passive_advanced introduced by the v1.1 slot progression. The 5★ heroes still do not have a true Ultimate; passive_advanced is a design-only enhancement positioned between passive_base and skill_2 in expressive identity, below 6★ prestige. Inert / catalog-only / read-only. Numbers deferred to balance pass.
